gch.body:
# Interactively checkout a git branch using fzf, sorted by most recent
if ! git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "Error: Not in a git repository." >&2
    return 1
fi

local branch
branch=$(git for-each-ref --count=30 --sort=-committerdate refs/heads/ --format='%(refname:short)' | fzf --height=30% --reverse)

if [[ -n "$branch" ]]; then
    git checkout "$branch"
fi

glogf.body:
# Display git log with fzf and a preview window showing the commit diff.
if ! git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "Error: Not in a git repository." >&2
    return 1
fi

git log --graph --color=always \
    --format="%C(auto)%h%d %s %C(green)(%cr) %C(bold blue)<%an>%C(reset)" "$@" |
fzf --ansi --no-sort --reverse --tiebreak=index --height=80% \
    --preview "echo {} | grep -o '[a-f0-9]\{7\}' | head -1 | xargs -I@ git show --color=always @"

gwa.body:
# Check if the current directory is a git repository
    if ! git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree &>/dev/null; then
        echo "Not inside a git repository."
        return 1
    fi

    # Get the bare repository path
    local bare_repo_path
    bare_repo_path=$(git worktree list | grep bare | awk '{print $1}')

    # Check if the bare repository path is empty
    if [ -z "$bare_repo_path" ]; then
        echo "Bare repository not found."
        return 1
    fi

    # Check if the worktree name is provided
    local worktree_name="$1"
    if [ -z "$worktree_name" ]; then
        echo -n "Enter the worktree name: "
        read worktree_name
    fi

    # Create a new worktree
    git worktree add "$bare_repo_path/$worktree_name"

    # Check if inside a tmux session
    if [ -n "$TMUX" ]; then
        tmux-all "$bare_repo_path/$worktree_name"
        return 1
    fi
    z "$bare_repo_path/$worktree_name"

fcd.body:
# Use fd and fzf to fuzzy-find a directory and cd into it.
local dir
dir=$(fd --type d --hidden --exclude .git . | fzf --height=50% --reverse)

if [[ -n "$dir" ]]; then
    cd "$dir" || return
fi

fkill.body:
# Interactively find and kill a process using fzf.
local pid
pid=$(ps -ef | sed 1d | fzf -m --height=50% --reverse | awk '{print $2}')

if [[ -n "$pid" ]]; then
    # Convert the newline-separated pids into a space-separated list
    local pids_to_kill
    pids_to_kill=$(echo "$pid" | xargs)
    
    echo "You are about to kill the following process(es):"
    # Get the process names for confirmation
    ps -o comm= -p $pids_to_kill
    
    # Ask for confirmation
    read -q "choice?Are you sure? (y/n) "
    echo # Move to the next line
    if [[ "$choice" == "y" ]]; then
        # Use xargs to kill all selected pids
        echo "$pid" | xargs kill -9
        echo "Process(es) killed."
    else
        echo "Kill operation cancelled."
    fi
fi

mkcd.body:
# Create a new directory and change into it.
if [[ -z "$1" ]]; then
    echo "Usage: mkcd <directory-name>" >&2
    return 1
fi
mkdir -p "$1" && cd "$1"

serve.body:
# Start a simple Python web server in the current directory.
local port="${1:-8000}"
local ip
ip=$(ifconfig en0 | grep "inet " | cut -d " " -f 2)
echo "Serving HTTP on http://${ip}:${port}/ and http://0.0.0.0:${port}/ ..."
echo "Press Ctrl-C to stop."
# The -u flag ensures output is not buffered, so it stops cleanly.
python3 -u -m http.server "$port"

wezterm.body:
if command -v wezterm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    command wezterm "$@"
else
    flatpak run org.wezfurlong.wezterm "$@"
fi

tmux-all.body:
if [ -z "$1" ]; then
    echo "Usage: tmux-all '<command>'"
    return 1
fi

local cmd="$1"
tmux list-panes -F '#{pane_id}' | while read -r pane; do
tmux send-keys -t "$pane" "$cmd" C-m
done
